Name: Invite Friend
Author: d5a1lamdtd
TagLine: Invite any villagers to visit your house!!!
Description:
___This mod is a part of my bigger mod___ [Market Town](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309)
**Invite villagers to visit your place the next day**Have you ever spent hours decorating your house into a dream place and spent other hours trying to cook all the dishes? And after all that excitement you realize that nobody else sees those beauties except yourself? Now, let's invite some of your friends over and have a party that never existed before!!!

 ![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/973700992321327125/1107473007175286836/line.png)

**How to use:**

*   [Check out my guide video](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309?tab=videos#lg=2&slide=0)

*   **_Talk to villagers_**. After daily conversation, you will see a pop-up where you can invite them.

*   **_Or using the chatbox._** You can stand close by them and type in your message. The invitation must include the keyword "invite"
And that's it, they will visit your farm the next day (some of them might forget, though)
**The more heart you have, the higher the chance they will accept your invitation!!!**

**Compatibility**

*   Not compatible with [Market Town](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309) : this feature is included in the main mod

*   Compatible with [Farmhouse Visit](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12457), although the schedule for NPCs might be a little different.

*   Work for NPCs from any mods

*   No conflict found.
![](https://i.ibb.co/db5Xwk0/3.webp)
